lanes.summary: AI logging lets you fix a bad match: Voice Log results come with "Try Again" and Log, and Meal Scan lets you search for anything it missed. Help says Voice Log does not work offline and points you to search by name. A server failure at sign-in shows "Unable to Connect to the Server", and Help's fix is to reinstall. No usage limits or error screen were observed.
steps: No limit or error screen seen

lanes.summary: Logout lands on the signed-out Welcome screen, and sign-in offers Continue, Google and Apple. Wrong details show "Invalid Email or Password", and Help gives the fix: Forgot Password, check spam, Hide My Email forwarding. A cancelled Apple or Google sheet was not observed. Help warns that entries not yet synced are lost on reinstall.

The diary follows the login across app and web and syncs on its own when online, with a manual More › Sync row. The Apple Watch app feeds Today, and Help's fix for a stuck watch is More › Sync. Sharing is social (Friends, "Diary Sharing" Private/Public/Friends Only/Locked), not a shared household diary, and per-device ad choices don't follow the account.
sources: https://support.myfitnesspal.com/hc/en-us/articles/360032625731-Apple-Watch-App (More › Sync if watch data won't sync)
